'''2005 Young Jedi World Championship''' was the 2005 world championship of the [[Young Jedi]] collectible card game, played at Gen Con.<ref name="pcf-7449-100086">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=100086#100086 Just out of curiousity], lawtalkingguy, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (8 September 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060617235318/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=7449 Internet Archive]</ref> [[Brad Eier]] won it and a player posting as Booker finished second; Booker congratulated Eier on the forum on 22 August 2005.<ref name="pcf-6033-97195">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=97195#97195 FREE Young Jedi Sealed Deck tournament!], Booker, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (22 August 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060617235414/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=6033&view=next Internet Archive]</ref> In February 2006 [[Tim Simon]] called Eier the "Young Jedi ccg World Champion 2005".<ref name="pcf-9009-123768">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=123768#123768 The waiting is over.......Y4 Regional 2006 Info is here!], Tim Simon (Aglets), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 February 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095832/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=9009&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref>

Eier wrote that he and his opponent each bought a box of the Enhanced Menace of Darth Maul set, 12 premium cards and 48 packs for $5 a box, and that they played one game, Eier with the Dark Side and his opponent with the Light Side.<ref name="pcf-6033-97395">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=97395#97395 FREE Young Jedi Sealed Deck tournament!], Brad Eier, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 August 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060617235414/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=6033&view=next Internet Archive]</ref> A player posting as lawtalkingguy wrote that if he had been able to go to Gen Con he "would have increased attendance at 2005 YJ Worlds by fifty percent".<ref name="pcf-7449-100086" />
